The last game update introduced a huge change in balance. Being titled as "it is a bug" and "was never intended in the original game design", the Game Studio has changed and removed a main feature for collecting speed-ups during end-game. While the functionality may not have been originally intended to work the way it does, realising this over a year into the game and changing it entirely to the disadvantage of the players (they now need to pay for what was free before) is pretty uncool.

So the developers of the game decided that even the tiniest rewards that players didn't have to pay for should be removed claiming that they were a "bug" that was active for over a year... As of right now, the game is practically dead, you get a million pop-ups about things you can buy and that's most of what you can do. Shame, it was fun while it lasted I guess. Monotonous and expensive, I'd look elsewhere.

Yet another game that lies in its ads.. It's certainly getting tiring to see these. Not at all what is advertised. Edit: to respond to the dev's reply - yes, it's cleat that your game focuses a lot more on other stuff, but none of it is "fun". It's mostly a bait and switch to get players to purchase packs in order to be able to advance. As for the gameplay shown on yours ads, almost none of it is featured in the actual game. This used to be illegal and considered deceitful advertising.

The quality of the game has lowered on a daily basis. It used to be a fun game to play, and enjoy, now everything is designed to make players constantly spend money. After 250 days of play, I’m changing my review from 5 stars to 1. Developers removed speedup rewards that existed since day one, then claimed it was an “unintended bug.” For many players, this was normal progression, not an exploit. Now the game feels less fair, more grind-heavy, and more focused on pushing spending. Players invested time and money under one set of rules, then the rules changed. The community is upset, many will quit, and I can’t recommend this game.
